title: alternanthera achyrantha var. leiantha
intro: Alternanthera achyrantha var. leiantha, commonly known as Joy Weed or Calico Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Amaranthaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alternanthera achyrantha var. leiantha include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making it a valuable herb in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been isolated and characterized in various studies.
